subject: CloudWell onboarding + premium support bundle — exec approval request
thread_summary: Sales rep requests executive approval for a bundled onboarding + premium support package including a 30% first-year discount and a custom integration scope; legal and finance weigh in; VP approves with condition on success milestones and limited credit exposure.
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: CloudWell SOW + premium support bundle — needs exec OK

Evelyn / Laura —

Had a long call with Amy at CloudWell. They're prepared to sign, but procurement pushed back on our standard pricing because they want the onboarding bundle (6 weeks integration) plus Premium Support (24/7) included in year one without additional professional services fees. They're asking for a 30% first-year credit against list to make the TCO fit their internal approval thresholds.

Key asks from CloudWell:
- Include onboarding SOW (custom ingress connector + 3rd-party telemetry integration) in year 1 at no separate charge
- Premium Support (P1 on-call, dedicated TAM) included for year 1
- 30% one-time first-year discount on platform + embeddings usage

Attached: proposed SOW v3 and my updated pricing sheet. This is a $1.1M ARR estimated Year 1 (including usage), potential multi-year with expansion to 50+ seats in year 2.

Why escalate: combination of non-standard T&Cs (no-charge professional services + deep custom integration) and the size of the discount exceeds deal-desk delegation. Need executive sign-off, and legal to confirm liability on third-party work.

Next steps I propose:
1) Exec OK for 30% first-year discount and inclusion of onboarding as prepaid hours (cap at 240 hours)
2) Legal to approve SOW language limiting scope + change control and capping professional services liability
3) Finance to confirm credit exposure and ARR recognition plan

Can we get a quick decision this week? CloudWell wants a signature by Nov 18.

Thanks,
Marcus
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudWell_SOW_v3.pdf, RW-pricing-quote-CW-DL8721.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudWell SOW + premium support bundle — needs exec OK

Thanks Marcus — good summary. Quick legal notes after a skim of SOW v3: 
- We need an explicit change-control clause for the custom telemetry integration; the language should make clear that additional scope will be charged at our standard PS day rate after the capped hours.
- Add an acceptance criteria section for the connector deliverables (tests, perf targets) before we hand over to Premium Support.
- Limit our indemnity and liability to the portion of work we perform; do not accept responsibility for third-party telemetry vendors.

I'll redline the SOW and return by EOD tomorrow. On the discount side, if leadership wants to include a 30% credit, let's gate it on prepayment for year 1 or commit to a two-year minimum. Credit exposure without commitment is a finance risk.

Laura
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudWell SOW + premium support bundle — needs exec OK

Team —

I've reviewed the numbers and the customer history. CloudWell has engaged in a 6-week pilot earlier this year and demonstrated strong usage patterns; expansion is realistic. I am generally supportive of approving the bundle with the following conditions:

1) Discount structure: 20% standard discount up front, with an additional 10% conditional credit applied after 6 months if CloudWell meets the agreed usage milestones (i.e., >=75% of forecasted token usage).
2) Onboarding hours: include onboarding as prepaid hours capped at 200 hours. Any overage billed at 50% of our standard PS rate for year 1.
3) Premium Support: include TAM and P1 coverage for year 1 but exclude SLA credits tied to custom integration failures (we'll provide response/triage but not credits for third-party outages).
4) Legal redlines accepted as Laura proposes. Monica, can you confirm the indemnity language and the change-control mechanism will be in the redline?
5) Finance needs to approve the payment terms — I prefer upfront 75% payment for year 1 or a signed two-year commitment.

Aditya — assigning to you for final exec sign-off if these controls are acceptable. Marcus, please brief Amy on the conditional structure so their procurement team sees the path to the full 30%.

Evelyn
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T08:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudWell SOW + premium support bundle — needs exec OK

Evelyn / team —

Thanks for the clear conditions. I'm comfortable approving the proposal with Evelyn's controls. Final approval notes:
- Approve up to 30% total effective first-year discount as structured (20% up front + 10% usage-contingent credit).
- Approve prepaid onboarding up to 200 hours; any overage billed at 50% PS rate in Y1.
- Approve inclusion of Premium Support (TAM + P1) for year 1 with exclusion of SLA credits for third-party issues.
- Require 75% upfront payment or signed two-year term before doc signing.

Monica, please finalize redline ASAP. Marcus — communicate approval and conditions to Amy, attach redlined SOW and the final pricing sheet, and instruct procurement to sign the DocuSign envelope once they confirm payment terms.

Aditya
VP, Sales

From: Amy Chen <amy@cloudwell.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwell.com
Date: 2026-11-15T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudWell SOW + premium support bundle — needs exec OK

Marcus / Evelyn / Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and clarity. The CloudWell procurement team reviewed the conditional structure and is willing to accept the milestone-based additional 10% credit and the 200-hour cap on onboarding as long as we receive a consolidated SOW and an invoice for 75% upfront. They also asked for a brief schedule of acceptance tests for the custom connector; can Laura include that in the SOW redline?

We'll sign the DocuSign and wire 75% within 7 business days after receiving the updated docs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Amy Chen
Director, Cloud Integrations — CloudWell Inc

Attachment references: final SOW to follow after legal redline.
